issue.title: Preserve held GPT evidence archives and maintain literal captured registry expectations

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

issue.body:
## What to build

Integrate the held #393 and #395 evidence-only commits into an isolated implementation branch, retaining their captured bytes, paths and measured outcomes. Maintain the independent literal registry expectation in `tests/test_run.py::test_the_registries_the_engine_finds_are_the_ones_this_repository_keeps` for the newly tracked captured numbered directories. The production `numbered_registries` detector keeps scanning the whole index.

Use physical external temporary storage for the unchanged project verification commands. A .git-contained temporary home changes the scheduler fixture’s storage interpretation; it is an acquisition environment problem, not authorization to alter the scheduler or its assertions. Preserve the original source trees and separate the original #395 xhigh/0.159.3 observations from the later high/0.160.0 completion.

The initial retained archive tips are `dfc30d08` (#393) and `a15fd957` (#395). Read their actual packets and complete live threads before integration. Other retained #488–#492 trees, main and rework are outside the writable surface. Root controls final main integration and closure.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every imported packet file and its path matches its retained/source evidence; failures, refusals, voids, skips, incomplete states and distinct seats remain explicit.
- [ ] An independent tracked-file and source-manifest audit supports each added literal directory maximum; the detector is unchanged, and evidence files are neither renamed nor rewritten.
- [ ] The exact registry inventory test passes after integration and does not derive expected values from the detector.
- [ ] Gate receipts use owned physical external temporary storage, preserve real HOME, and retain cleanup/process identities; no test is filtered or rewritten to compensate for an unsupported launch environment.
- [ ] A fresh independent verifier can assess bounded archive integration without treating historical full-report/controller summaries as current editorial quality authority.
- [ ] Run the four checks in CONTRIBUTING.md.

---

Written against `4cf05813`.
